definition: Establish the primary relational reference frame through which an external counterpart is encountered and engagement becomes reciprocal.
functionalAim: Orient attention toward the counterpart and the dynamics that emerge between self and other.

distinctions.ascendant: Ascendant orients the self toward experience; Descendant orients toward the counterpart in relationship.
distinctions.venus: Venus values and attracts; Descendant establishes the relational frame.
distinctions.seventh_house: The Descendant is a reference frame; the seventh house is a contextual domain.

constraints: Must always remain paired with the Ascendant.
Relational orientation is not relationship outcome.
